create_doctor: Add a doctor. Body: name, specialty (text). Returns the doctor including its id.
book_appointment: Book an appointment. Body: doctor_id, patient_name (text), date (YYYY-MM-DD), time (HH:MM, 24-hour, e.g. 09:00). Returns the appointment including its id. Refused when that doctor already has an appointment on that date at that time, or when the doctor does not exist.
list_doctor_appointments: List one doctor's appointments on one date. Path params: id (the doctor). Query params: date (YYYY-MM-DD).
cancel_appointment: Cancel (remove) an appointment, freeing its slot. Path params: id (the appointment). Refused if there is no such appointment.
